description: Replacement of a conservatory and erection of a single storey rear extension to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unreferenced Location Plan; Existing Property with Conservatory; Proposed Single Storey Extension
Received:  14 May 2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side and rear walls of the ground floor rear extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
